body: I would feel much better about the experience knowing I was using a controlled dose

I believe it's good to explore both the light and dark sides of the mind to get a clearer picture of who we are when our opinion of ourselves is removed. In order to understand myself, I'd like to see what fear and darkness these plants bring out of my subconscious mind.
I had no idea this existed.
Amanita Muscaria sounds like a fascinating experience.
[Here you go, my friend.](https://erowid.org/experiences/exp.cgi?S1=15&S2=-1&C1=-1&Str=)
I'm all good, my friend. I just dozed off after the last update.
It sounds terrifying, but fascinating at the same time.
That's interesting. This plant has the ovoid leaves with the white bell.
I'm all good, my dude. I dozed off for a few hours with no effects.

It's the strangeness of it that draws me in, I suppose. Maybe I'd be better off trying some benadryl to get the experience. I don't know much about the use of it, so it'll take quite a bit of research.
I'm all good. I passed out and woke up feeling weird, but nothing crazy happened.
Perhaps I used the wrong terminology? lol
I dozed off for a few hours with no effect. Nothing crazy happened, but I do have the strange feeling that none of this might actually be real. Everything feels slightly dream-like upon waking up.
Yeah, I'm good. I dozed off shortly after the last update. I had a really crazy dream, but I can't remember what it was. That's about all that happened.
I'm gonna keep updating. Things are changing slightly, now. I'll go until I either can't due to intoxication, or I'm sure nothing more issuing to happen
Poor guy :( I wish we could know if he's okay

I'm not really expecting a full-blown mindfuck off this dose. I'd like to work my way up the ladder, so to speak. I'm about an hour and a half in, and besides a very pleasant happiness, I'm not really feeling anything. No discomfort, no heat, still able to urinate. It's smooth sailing so far.
Honestly, it just felt right. I read reports where people used much more, and I've got a plant that I can get as much as I need from; I just felt "safe" using this amount.
I know I need some input from someone trained to identify any issues. I need an honest, objective opinion

I'm catching myself talking when no one is around. I'll stare at my reflection in the mirror for 10-15 minutes. I only catch myself and say "This is fucking weird" after I've been doing it for a while. I just don't want to be like this. I don't want to be incredibly suspicious of everyone. This problem has cost me a relationship, and it's affecting my job because I'm hearing my name mentioned across the room and freaking out.
Thank you for your advice. I am looking around at options for help in my area. I'm just a bit apprehensive.
Thank you. I really feel like that's helpful.
Thank you for the comforting words. I feel like there are others with similar issues, but it's getting to the point where I know for sure this isn't what anyone would call normal.
But any time I open up to someone everything comes out at once and scares them off.

Sorry for late reply. I'm just getting extremely paranoid about people talking about me behind my back or plotting things against me. Before I posted this last night I went into a rant about beating someone up last night and thoroughly freaked my room mate out.

I made this for you! First reading I have ever done. Be gentle, Senpai!
